_doc: C1 no-solana migration allowlist (Canton port; the reference's no-evm trick, D-016). Every entry is a Solana import or
dependency a C1 lane removes: 1c the web seat island, 1e the phone seat island, packages/clients deleted whole.
The list only shrinks: the rule fails on a stale entry, and the C1 gate requires this file to be empty.
An entry ending in / covers a directory prefix (a tree deleted whole).
